card.name: Ends of symptom and condition lists
card.fires_on: The word or punctuation right after a named symptom or condition, such as 'disease', a comma after 'confusion', or a closing bracket after 'fever'. It fires where a list of symptoms or health problems could continue or end.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom
modes.description: A comma following a symptom inside a list of signs and symptoms.

modes.description: A closing bracket or a small linking word right after a symptom noun.
modes.example: development of headache<< with>> a new pattern which is recurrent, persistent

card.writes: It lowers the odds of syndrome and disorder words (syndrome, PTSD, anxiety) coming next, so the text continues with plain symptom words.
card.plain: It marks the spot just after a symptom is named, where the list continues or the sentence moves on.
